Redefining How Banks Transact

Capstack Technologies is changing the way banks and credit unions work together. We’re breaking down geographic, operational and data silos to create a unified, digital marketplace for loan trading and collaboration.

By bringing banking and real-time communication tools into one secure platform, we’re not just streamlining workflows — we’re building a more open, efficient and connected financial system for the future.

Trusted by Industry Leaders

Curt Queyrouze,
President Coastal Community Bank

“Capstack Technologies has been a transformative partner in helping us diversify and access liquidity. Their platform made it easy to identify the right partner and seamlessly trade $50mm participations with a bank we had not worked with before. Capstack has streamlined the entire trading process end-to-end, making it simple, transparent and secure. We are actively engaging to have them market additional assets from our portfolio on their platform"

Kyle Leyendecker
President Northwest Bank

"Capstack Technologies offers an innovative solution that has greatly enhanced our asset sourcing process. Sourcing the right loans and trading partners, both within and outside our market, can be a complex challenge, but Capstack’s product has made the process more efficient. Their transparency and reliability have been key factors in our ability to close over $30 million in participations over the past few months."
